stages.name: The pull
stages.text: In, started, moving inside forty seconds. Nobody's curtain has twitched.
stages.fail_text: Immobiliser you didn't clock. Cuts out at the end of the road and you walk.

stages.name: The ring road
stages.text: Clean run to the dual carriageway. Two miles of nothing and a car that isn't yours behind you for one of them.
stages.fail_text: The car behind is a car behind. Right up until it isn't.

stages.name: The second one
stages.text: There's another on the same estate, same make, and Delroy pays double for a matched pair. It's a twenty-minute round trip. It's twenty minutes you've already used.
stages.fail_text: Somebody's up. Somebody's at a window with a phone. You've got maybe two minutes.

stages.name: The plates
stages.text: Delroy will pay more if it comes in on plates that aren't screaming. There's a scrapyard four miles the wrong way with a hundred to choose from.
stages.fail_text: There's a car in the scrapyard gate and it's not a scrapper.

stages.name: The long way
stages.text: Take it out of the city and there's a buyer who doesn't ask, doesn't haggle, and pays in one go. Two hours on an A-road in a stolen car with a hot plate on it.
stages.fail_text: Roadside check outside Coventry. Not even for you. Just the wrong minute of the wrong hour.
